body: Trusted controls/private permanently retired keys/isolated endpoint storage are actual resources. Learning requires a common joint algebra and excitation; guard soundness does not certify that model or ensure availability. The1/128 bound is accepted-subnormalized, not normalized fidelity for every accepted run.
